pick.headline: Six US diplomats escape Iran with Canadian help
pick.summary: On January 28, 1980, six American diplomats who had evaded capture when the US Embassy was seized flew out of Tehran on Canadian passports.
pick.significance: The 'Canadian caper', publicly credited to Canada's embassy, was a joint operation with the CIA, whose role was declassified only in 1997.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of January 31, 1980, listed under United States & Canada a "Report of U.S. Diplomats' Escape From Iran Cited", among Moscow attacks on the Carter Doctrine and on the U.S. Olympic boycott campaign.

alternates.headline: Space shuttle Challenger explodes
alternates.summary: On January 28, 1986, the space shuttle Challenger broke apart 73 seconds after launch, killing all seven crew.
alternates.significance: The disaster grounded the shuttle fleet for nearly three years and delayed US military and reconnaissance satellite launches.
alternates.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of January 29, 1986, listed a late report of Polish reaction to the shuttle disaster, with AFP on the Pentagon's "weaknesses" and Urban's sympathies, and under Romania, Ceausescu's condolences on the Challenger explosion.
